parameters.content:
# NotifyError

Owned By: Diego Alvarez
Last Updated: 09/22/2026

Reusable error-notification subworkflow. Receives a normalized error payload from any parent workflow and posts a consistently formatted, safely-escaped Slack alert — replacing per-branch Code+Slack duplication.

## Expected Flow
1. ReceiveErrorNotificationRequest: Execute Workflow Trigger; defines input schema (severity, title, sourceWorkflowId, sourceExecutionId, details)
2. BuildErrorNotificationBlocks: Normalizes "details" (string/object/null-safe), truncates long content, and builds Slack Block Kit JSON
3. PostErrorToSlack: Sends the message using Message Type "Blocks", with blocksUi wrapped as {"blocks": [...]}

## Resiliency & Error Handling
- Safe Serialization: details is JSON.stringify'd and backtick-escaped to prevent block-parsing failures regardless of source content shape
- Traceability: includes a direct link to the triggering execution in n8n, so the on-call person doesn't have to reconstruct context manually
- Single Source of Truth: any future fix to Slack formatting/escaping only needs to happen here, not in every calling branch
